purpose: Document the 2012 precinct-geography repairs used by the NHGIS block-disaggregation pilot.

sources.vest_rdh_2016_block_file: Data/tn_2016_gen_2020_blocks.zip (local source file supplied by the project owner)

implemented_repairs.montgomery: 2012 labels are assigned to the union of all 2010 Census VTDs sharing the same leading precinct number.
implemented_repairs.wilson: 2012 labels are assigned to the union of all 2010 Census VTDs sharing the same leading precinct number; this replaces an erroneous trailing-token match for precinct 9-3.
implemented_repairs.sullivan: 17 lettered precinct codes with unambiguous polling-place matches are assigned to 2010 VTDs; nine uncertain renamed locations remain on county fallback.
implemented_repairs.washington: 12 unique polling-place or city-side matches are assigned to 2010 VTDs; unresolved labels remain on county fallback.
implemented_repairs.knox: Five exact polling-place/code matches are assigned to single VTDs or explicit VTD unions.
implemented_repairs.madison: Eight exact 2010 VTD-code and polling-place matches are assigned to VTDs.

stable_2016_block_proxy_pilot.method: Use the supplied VEST/RDH 2016-on-2020-block file only where a normal election-day precinct retained the same distinctive code or name from 2012 through 2016.

hamilton.match_basis: All ordinary 2012 precinct names match unique 2016 names after expanding only E, N, and Mtn abbreviations; seven new 2016 precincts are excluded.

washington.match_basis: All 40 ordinary precinct numbers persist; Early/Absentee remains ballot-constrained fallback.

madison.match_basis: Every 2012 precinct code and polling-place label persists in the 2016 VEST/RDH block file.

hardeman.match_basis: Every 2012 polling-place name persists exactly in the 2016 VEST/RDH block file.

haywood.match_basis: Unique precinct numbers 1-8 and 10 persist; ambiguous 2012 precincts 9-1 and 9-2 remain on historical VTD geometry.

montgomery.match_basis: Every 2012 precinct code persists in the 2016 VEST/RDH block file; suffix-level block footprints replace the earlier grouped-leading-number VTD unions.

rutherford.match_basis: All 46 2012 precinct codes persist in the 2016 VEST/RDH block file; four new/cross-county 2016 records are excluded.

williamson.match_basis: All 40 2012 precinct codes persist in the 2016 VEST/RDH block file; three new 2016 precincts are excluded.

marshall.match_basis: Seven polling-place identities persist. West Hills/Parkview Baptist and Courthouse/McKnight Center remain historical because their continuity is not explicit.

house_ballot_constrained_fallback_pilot.method: Allocate each fallback bucket among 2012 State House districts in proportion to that bucket's State House votes, then distribute within each old-plan district using block VAP.

house_75_president.finding: The earlier R+5.59 pilot flip disappears when suffix-level Montgomery precincts use their stable 2016 block footprints. The live D+0.04 and revised D+0.80 results agree on the winner.

house_80_us_senate.finding: The Democratic flip persists after replacing Madison, Hardeman, and unambiguous Haywood VTD footprints with stable 2016 block assignments. This strongly indicates the live R+4.02 result is a geography-allocation artifact rather than a fallback artifact.

near_whole_county_residual_rule.measure: 2020-block VAP_MOD share of each county in its dominant current-plan district
near_whole_county_residual_rule.method: Estimate only votes in non-dominant district slivers, subtract them from each certified county-party total, and assign the exact residual to the dominant district.
near_whole_county_residual_rule.result: The audit found 142 chamber-specific county/dominant-district pairs meeting the threshold. Every adjustment delta was zero because the existing source allocation already conserves certified totals independently within each county; the rule therefore validates and documents those whole-county assignments without changing votes.

hamilton_hybrid_early_vote_pilot.method: For Hamilton non-geographic buckets, iterative proportional fitting preserves each bucket's certified presidential or U.S. Senate party totals and its 2012 State House ballot totals by old district. Stable ordinary precincts supply old-district partisan priors; the fitted old-district totals are then distributed to blocks within that district.
hamilton_hybrid_early_vote_pilot.finding: The hybrid moves all five Hamilton House presidential margins toward the published results except HD28, where it passes the published D+58.63 to D+63.73. This confirms that equal-party allocation of early votes was the main Hamilton distortion. Senate-plan effects are small because current SD10 and SD11 each combine several old House districts.

publication_blockers: Fallback votes outside Hamilton are ballot-constrained to the 2012 House plan, but the district shares use State House votes as a turnout proxy rather than presidential ballot counts.
Hamilton now uses a two-margin IPF hybrid for non-geographic votes, but its old-district partisan priors are estimates from ordinary precincts and should remain labeled estimated.
Historical Davidson precinct polygons for the new 2012 precinct labels have not been recovered.
Publishing now would introduce House margin changes as large as 13.4881 percentage points for president and 28.1875 points for U.S. Senate.
